text.en: Several pet parents report that their dogs and house rabbits settled well and returned home happy and healthy following boarding stays. However, two reviewers raised serious concerns regarding pet health and stress, including an untreated eye condition in a cat and high distress observed upon collection. Overall experiences with animal welfare remain divided.

Clients appreciate the convenient Yeadon location next to Leeds Bradford Airport, as well as on-site amenities including the grooming salon and pet supplies shop. On the other hand, one reviewer noted disappointment after being unable to view the kennels during collection, leaving mixed impressions regarding facility transparency.

Many clients praise staff members for going out of their way to accommodate schedules, provide reassuring telephone updates, and bathe pets before return. Conversely, one client reported a disorganized reception experience with forgetful staff, resulting in mixed perceptions regarding customer interaction and administrative attentiveness.

q.en: Where is Carlton Boarding Kennels located?

a.en: The facility is situated at Carlton Hall Farm in Yeadon, immediately adjacent to Leeds Bradford Airport.

q.en: What pet species can be boarded at the facility?

a.en: The premises provide accommodation for dogs, cats in dedicated chalets, and small animals including rabbits.

q.en: Are vaccinations required prior to boarding?

a.en: Yes, all boarding pets must have up-to-date vaccination records verified before their stay.

q.en: Are grooming services available on site during a pet's stay?

a.en: Yes, an on-site grooming parlour allows owners to arrange bathing and grooming packages during boarding.
